import hashlib,itertools,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from lottolab.research import b649_branch2_controlled_overlap_m3_generator_r1 as gen
from lottolab.research import b649_k20_three_ticket_single_number_cycle_r1 as ttc
from lottolab.research import b649_official_any_prize_exact as canonical

root=Path.cwd().resolve()
outdir=root/".task-data/B649_BRANCH2_V6_CONTROLLED_OVERLAP_M3_EXACT_SCAN_R1"
freeze_path=outdir/"freeze.json"
freeze=json.loads(freeze_path.read_text())
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
identity={
    "GENERATOR_SHA256":sha(root/"src/lottolab/research/b649_branch2_controlled_overlap_m3_generator_r1.py"),
    "TEST_SHA256":sha(root/"tests/unit/test_b649_branch2_controlled_overlap_m3_generator_r1.py"),
    "SCORER_SHA256":sha(root/"src/lottolab/research/b649_k20_three_ticket_single_number_cycle_r1.py"),
    "CANONICAL_EVALUATOR_SHA256":sha(root/"src/lottolab/research/b649_official_any_prize_exact.py"),
    "V6_SHA256":sha(root/ttc.STARTING_DONOR_ARTIFACT),
}
for key,value in identity.items():
    if freeze.get(key)!=value:
        raise SystemExit("FROZEN_IDENTITY_MISMATCH:"+key)
if freeze.get("VERIFICATION_REBIND_STATUS")!="PASS":
    raise SystemExit("VERIFICATION_REBIND_NOT_PASS")
v6_raw=(root/ttc.STARTING_DONOR_ARTIFACT).read_bytes()
v6=json.loads(v6_raw)
if (v6.get("PORTFOLIO_SHA256")!=ttc.STARTING_PORTFOLIO_SHA256 or
        v6.get("WINNING_OUTCOMES")!=ttc.STARTING_COUNT or
        ttc.STARTING_COUNT!=313239647 or
        ttc.STARTING_PORTFOLIO_SHA256!="0c52a1f0bed90cd47d08bb031b13c9bf693317493f88e45da8e087bd4a0ab65b"):
    raise SystemExit("SCIENTIFIC_ANCHOR_MISMATCH")
portfolio=ttc.normalize_portfolio(v6["TICKETS"],pool_size=49,expected_ticket_count=20)
if ttc.portfolio_sha256(portfolio,pool_size=49)!=ttc.STARTING_PORTFOLIO_SHA256:
    raise SystemExit("SCIENTIFIC_PORTFOLIO_HASH_MISMATCH")
draws=canonical.all_main_draw_masks(49,6)
anchor=canonical.evaluate_portfolio(portfolio,pool_size=49,draw_size=6,outright_matches=3,draws=draws)
if anchor.official_any_prize_outcome_count!=313239647:
    raise SystemExit("SCIENTIFIC_CANONICAL_ANCHOR_MISMATCH")

triple_accounting=[]
candidate_rows=[]
portfolios={}
locations={}
for triple_index,slots in enumerate(itertools.combinations(range(20),3),start=1):
    replacements=list(gen.iter_controlled_overlap_replacements(portfolio,slots,pool_size=49))
    triple_accounting.append({"TRIPLE":list(slots),"CANDIDATE_COUNT":len(replacements)})
    if replacements:
        residual=ttc.build_triple_residual(portfolio,slots,pool_size=49,draws=draws)
        for replacement in replacements:
            replaced=gen.replacement_portfolio(portfolio,slots,replacement,pool_size=49)
            portfolio_sha=ttc.portfolio_sha256(replaced,pool_size=49)
            if portfolio_sha in portfolios and portfolios[portfolio_sha]!=replaced:
                raise SystemExit("PORTFOLIO_SHA256_COLLISION")
            portfolios[portfolio_sha]=replaced
            locations.setdefault(portfolio_sha,[]).append(list(slots))
            count=int(residual.outcome_count(replacement.tickets))
            candidate_rows.append({
                "TRIPLE":list(slots),
                "TICKETS":[list(ticket) for ticket in replacement.tickets],
                "PORTFOLIO_SHA256":portfolio_sha,
                "RESIDUAL_COUNT":count,
                "DELTA_VS_313239647":count-313239647,
                "CANONICAL_COUNT":None,
            })
    if triple_index%100==0:
        print("ENUMERATION_PROGRESS",triple_index,len(candidate_rows),flush=True)

total_triples=len(triple_accounting)
producing_triples=sum(row["CANDIDATE_COUNT"]>0 for row in triple_accounting)
total_candidates=len(candidate_rows)
max_candidates=max((row["CANDIDATE_COUNT"] for row in triple_accounting),default=0)
accounting_match=(total_triples==1140 and producing_triples==186 and
                  total_candidates==1204 and max_candidates==42)
if not candidate_rows:
    raise SystemExit("NO_FAMILY_A_CANDIDATES")
best_row=sorted(candidate_rows,key=lambda row:(-row["RESIDUAL_COUNT"],row["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"],tuple(row["TRIPLE"])))[0]
best_sha=best_row["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"]
strict_hashes={row["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"] for row in candidate_rows if row["RESIDUAL_COUNT"]>313239647}
parity_salt="B649_BRANCH2_V6_CONTROLLED_OVERLAP_M3_EXACT_SCAN_R1|PARITY"
parity_order=sorted(candidate_rows,key=lambda row:(
    hashlib.sha256((parity_salt+"|"+row["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"]+"|"+",".join(map(str,row["TRIPLE"]))).encode()).hexdigest(),
    row["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"],tuple(row["TRIPLE"])))
parity_hashes=[]
parity_seen=set()
for row in parity_order:
    if row["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"] not in parity_seen:
        parity_hashes.append(row["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"])
        parity_seen.add(row["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"])
    if len(parity_hashes)==32:
        break
if len(parity_hashes)<32:
    raise SystemExit("INSUFFICIENT_DETERMINISTIC_PARITY_CANDIDATES")
recount_reasons={}
for digest in strict_hashes:
    recount_reasons.setdefault(digest,set()).add("STRICT_IMPROVER")
recount_reasons.setdefault(best_sha,set()).add("GLOBAL_BEST")
for digest in parity_hashes:
    recount_reasons.setdefault(digest,set()).add("DETERMINISTIC_PARITY")
canonical_counts={}
recount_rows=[]
for index,digest in enumerate(sorted(recount_reasons),start=1):
    candidate=portfolios[digest]
    result=canonical.evaluate_portfolio(
        [tuple(ticket) for ticket in candidate],
        pool_size=49,draw_size=6,outright_matches=3,draws=draws)
    canonical_count=int(result.official_any_prize_outcome_count)
    canonical_counts[digest]=canonical_count
    residual_count=next(row["RESIDUAL_COUNT"] for row in candidate_rows if row["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"]==digest)
    reasons=sorted(recount_reasons[digest])
    recount_rows.append({
        "PORTFOLIO_SHA256":digest,
        "TRIPLE_REFERENCES":locations[digest],
        "RESIDUAL_COUNT":residual_count,
        "CANONICAL_COUNT":canonical_count,
        "DELTA_VS_313239647":canonical_count-313239647,
        "RECOUNT_REASONS":reasons,
        "PARITY_CANDIDATE":"DETERMINISTIC_PARITY" in reasons,
        "STRICT_IMPROVER":"STRICT_IMPROVER" in reasons,
        "GLOBAL_BEST":"GLOBAL_BEST" in reasons,
    })
    if canonical_count!=residual_count:
        print("EXACT_KERNEL_PARITY_MISMATCH",digest,residual_count,canonical_count,flush=True)
    if index%8==0 or index==len(recount_reasons):
        print("CANONICAL_RECOUNT_PROGRESS",index,len(recount_reasons),flush=True)
for row in candidate_rows:
    row["CANONICAL_COUNT"]=canonical_counts.get(row["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"])
mismatches=[row for row in recount_rows if row["RESIDUAL_COUNT"]!=row["CANONICAL_COUNT"]]
best_residual=int(best_row["RESIDUAL_COUNT"])
best_canonical=canonical_counts.get(best_sha)
if mismatches:
    family_status="EXACT_KERNEL_PARITY_FAILURE"
elif not accounting_match:
    family_status="EXACT_SCAN_ACCOUNTING_FAILURE"
elif best_residual>313239647:
    family_status="COMPLETE_GAIN_FOUND"
else:
    family_status="COMPLETE_NO_GAIN"
result={
    **identity,
    "VERIFICATION_REBIND_STATUS":"PASS",
    "FREEZE_RECORD_SHA256":sha(freeze_path),
    "SCIENTIFIC_ANCHOR":{"COUNT":313239647,"PORTFOLIO_SHA256":ttc.STARTING_PORTFOLIO_SHA256,
                         "CANONICAL_RECOUNT_COUNT":int(anchor.official_any_prize_outcome_count)},
    "SCORING_METHOD":"TripleResidual.outcome_count",
    "CANONICAL_RECOUNT_METHOD":"b649_official_any_prize_exact.evaluate_portfolio",
    "RESOURCE_EXECUTION":"one Python process; nice increment 15; numerical-library thread caps set to 1",
    "TOTAL_TRIPLES":total_triples,
    "PRODUCING_TRIPLES":producing_triples,
    "TOTAL_CANDIDATES":total_candidates,
    "MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_TRIPLE":max_candidates,
    "ACCOUNTING_MATCH":accounting_match,
    "STRICT_IMPROVER_COUNT":sum(row["RESIDUAL_COUNT"]>313239647 for row in candidate_rows),
    "GLOBAL_BEST_TRIPLE":best_row["TRIPLE"],
    "BEST_RESIDUAL_COUNT":best_residual,
    "BEST_CANONICAL_COUNT":best_canonical,
    "BEST_PORTFOLIO_SHA256":best_sha,
    "BEST_PORTFOLIO":[list(ticket) for ticket in portfolios[best_sha]],
    "DELTA_VS_313239647":best_residual-313239647,
    "DETERMINISTIC_PARITY_CANDIDATE_COUNT":len(parity_hashes),
    "CANONICAL_RECOUNTED_UNIQUE_CANDIDATE_COUNT":len(recount_rows),
    "PARITY_MISMATCH_COUNT":len(mismatches),
    "PARITY_MISMATCHES":mismatches,
    "FAMILY_A_V6_STATUS":family_status,
    "TRIPLE_ACCOUNTING":triple_accounting,
    "CANDIDATES":candidate_rows,
    "CANONICAL_RECOUNTS":recount_rows,
}
result_path=outdir/"result.json"
result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
result_sha=sha(result_path)
print("TERMINAL_RESULT",json.dumps({
    "GENERATOR_SHA256":identity["GENERATOR_SHA256"],
    "TEST_SHA256":identity["TEST_SHA256"],
    "VERIFICATION_REBIND_STATUS":"PASS",
    "TOTAL_TRIPLES":total_triples,
    "PRODUCING_TRIPLES":producing_triples,
    "TOTAL_CANDIDATES":total_candidates,
    "MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_TRIPLE":max_candidates,
    "STRICT_IMPROVER_COUNT":result["STRICT_IMPROVER_COUNT"],
    "BEST_RESIDUAL_COUNT":best_residual,
    "BEST_CANONICAL_COUNT":best_canonical,
    "BEST_PORTFOLIO_SHA256":best_sha,
    "DELTA_VS_313239647":best_residual-313239647,
    "FAMILY_A_V6_STATUS":family_status,
    "RESULT_SHA256":result_sha,
    "RESULT_PATH":str(result_path),
},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
if family_status=="EXACT_KERNEL_PARITY_FAILURE":
    sys.exit(31)
if family_status=="EXACT_SCAN_ACCOUNTING_FAILURE":
    sys.exit(32)
